subject: DNg02

subject: SApp08 population

subject: SApp08 population

subject: SNpp37/38 left population

subject: bilateral ORN_DM1/ORN_VA2 model readout
scope: Synthetic injection into bilateral ORN_DM1/ORN_VA2 at 0.25 times concentration for 20 ticks of 20 ms; normalized left-right ORN counts; decoder trained on seeds 500-507, checked on seeds 800-803; 40 nonzero pairs; decoder sign accuracy 40/40 and MAE 0.0479516 across all 44 pairs
limitation: This is a fixed-model receptor readout on artificial doses, not a natural odor-direction circuit or evidence of an ORN-to-motor path

subject: selected bilateral DM1_lPN/VA2_adPN model readout
object: 9/40 nonzero held-out odor pairs; 27 ties and 4 opposite signs
scope: Raw left-right summed spike counts of four selected PN; bilateral ORN_DM1/ORN_VA2 artificial injection at 0.25 times concentration for 20 ticks of 20 ms; seeds 800-803; 40 nonzero concentration differences
limitation: Negative result for this selection, window, and raw count readout only; does not establish absence of PN information or an anatomical ORN-PN path

subject: 16 bilateral T4/T5 model groups
scope: Horizontal bright-bar movie projected to 6006 receptors using approximate 1D azimuth; 10 blank warmup ticks plus 50 frames at 20 ms; 12 paired seeds 7-18; none of 16 T4/T5 groups kept one direction-difference sign across all seeds; mean total spikes across groups: 8075.5 left-to-right, 8166.7 right-to-left, 8166.8 stationary
limitation: No reliable direction effect demonstrated in this probe; 1D projection and uncalibrated dynamics limit inference and do not refute living-fly T4/T5 function

subject: selected SNpp37/38/06 cells in flybrain
scope: Candidate selected on four training seeds; separate left and right excitation at +0.6 extra voltage per tick for 30 ticks after 20 warmup ticks, compared with paired no-stimulation rest; on 12 held-out noise seeds 1200-1211, left stimulation mean effect -2.58 and right +1.83 spikes; opposite signs in 12/12 pairs
limitation: Open-loop response of a fixed hand-calibrated model to artificial stimulation; seeds vary noise, not connectome anatomy; no natural wing reflex or synaptic path is established

subject: selected IN08B051_d cells in flybrain
scope: Candidate selected on four training seeds; separate left and right excitation at 0.6 times gain 0.6732337 extra voltage per tick for 30 ticks after 20 warmup ticks, compared with paired no-stimulation rest; on 12 held-out noise seeds 1200-1211, left stimulation mean effect -1.33 and right +1.75 spikes; opposite signs in 9/12 pairs
limitation: Open-loop fixed-model result for a search-selected type label, not a measured biological reflex or proof of a direct connection to i1/i2

subject: T4b_R in flybrain with 2D receptor input
scope: Same 64x64 bright-bar frames and paired noise resets; 2D column-based receptor projection with only right eye stimulated; 10 blank ticks and 50 movie ticks of 20 ms; positive difference in 12/12 seeds 19-30, mean +19.25 spikes
limitation: Small effect in a hand-calibrated model; receptor angles and camera orientation uncalibrated; not evidence of robust direction tuning across stimuli or transmission to motor output

subject: T4b_R in flybrain with 2D receptor input
scope: Phase-matched moving gratings begin with the same frame and contain the same frames in reverse order; right eye stimulated; 10 blank ticks and 50 movie ticks of 20 ms; positive difference in 7/12 seeds at high contrast (mean +1.58 spikes) and 5/12 at low contrast (mean -2.75 spikes)
limitation: This negative replication limits the 2D bright-bar finding N-013; it does not refute physiological T4/T5 direction selectivity

subject: T4b_R in flybrain with 2D receptor input
scope: Synthetic phase-matched 64x64 gratings to the right eye via a fixed 2D receptor map and flybrain==0.1.0; paired resets on held-out noise seeds 35-42, 10 blank ticks then 50 movie ticks of 20 ms; main 4-period phase-0 condition yielded mean +17.125 spikes and 7/8 positive pairs at speed 4 and contrast +/-95, but phase-only, period-only, and joint holdouts yielded -4.375, -0.25, and -8.875 spikes with 5/8, 4/8, and 3/8 positive pairs
limitation: Model response on an uncalibrated artificial receptor projection; one fixed connectome and dynamics; does not establish or refute physiological T4/T5 motion tuning
